summary: On node1 (RHEL 7), persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance via /etc/sysctl.d/98-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route set to 0 for all/default/eth0/lo), applied live, then completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued systemctl reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reset, and reverified all sysctl values and the config file remained correct post-reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values showing accept_redirects=1 (needed hardening) and accept_source_route=0 for all/default
Created /etc/sysctl.d/98-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for all, default, eth0, and lo
Applied config live with sudo sysctl -p and verified all four scopes (all/default/eth0/lo) read 0 for all three keys

Checked for conflicting sysctl definitions in /etc/sysctl.conf, /etc/sysctl.d/, /usr/lib/sysctl.d/ - found only /usr/lib/sysctl.d/50-default.conf setting accept_source_route=0, non-conflicting and lower precedence than the new 98- file
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1; connection closed confirming acknowledgement
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again (first attempt timed out, second succeeded)
Verified new boot_id (bc9e8061-df32-48a1-ad3b-a47de60a6b68) differs from baseline and uptime reset to ~10s, proving a genuine restart
Re-verified all sysctl hardening values (all/default/eth0/lo) remained 0 post-reboot and confirmed the persisted config file content matches what was written

evidence.requirement: Baseline state before hardening (accept_redirects=1 needing fix)
evidence.summary: Showed all/default accept_redirects=1 and accept_source_route=0 before the fix was applied

evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created for IPv4 redirect/source-route hardening
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/98-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf and applied it live with sysctl -p, output confirms all keys set to 0

evidence.requirement: Live sysctl values confirmed disabled for all scopes (all/default/eth0/lo)
evidence.summary: Per-interface check showed eth0/lo initially retained accept_redirects=1/accept_source_route=1 until corrected; second check confirms all scopes at 0

evidence.requirement: No conflicting sysctl source overriding the hardening
evidence.summary: Only /usr/lib/sysctl.d/50-default.conf also sets accept_source_route=0 (non-conflicting, lower precedence than 98- file)
systemctl reboot issued; connection closed by remote host confirming the command was accepted before disconnect

evidence.requirement: Node restart recovery / command execution available again
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node rebooting), second poll succeeded confirming exec access restored

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving genuine restart
evidence.summary: New boot_id bc9e8061-df32-48a1-ad3b-a47de60a6b68 differs from baseline, and /proc/uptime reset to ~10s

evidence.requirement: Post-restart persistence of hardening settings and config file
evidence.summary: All sysctl values (all/default/eth0/lo) remained 0 for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route after reboot, and the config file content is unchanged on disk
